What We Do

Expert Services for Every Space

From a single room refresh to a full home transformation, we bring skill, care, and precision to every project.

Kitchen Renovation

Complete kitchen transformations — layout redesign, custom cabinetry, countertops, backsplash, and finishing touches.

Bathroom Renovation

Full bath remodels — tile work, vanities, shower enclosures, and plumbing-ready finishes designed to feel like a personal spa.

Custom Cabinetry

Handcrafted cabinets built to your specs — every drawer, hinge, and finish selected for beauty and lasting durability.

Carpentry & Trim

Crown molding, baseboards, wainscoting, built-ins, and finish carpentry that add character and value to any room.

Tile Installation

Expert tile work for floors, backsplashes, showers, and walls — precision cuts and flawless grouting every time.

Drywall & Painting

Seamless drywall installation, repair, and professional painting — smooth walls and perfect finishes from top to bottom.

Framing

Structural framing for additions, new walls, and room layouts — the strong foundation every great renovation needs.

Complete Interior Remodeling

Whole-home transformations managed start to finish. We coordinate every trade and deliver a cohesive, beautiful result.

About Us

Craftsmanship That Speaks for Itself

Palacio Woodwork LLC was founded on one simple principle: every home deserves to be treated with the same care and precision as a fine piece of furniture. Based in South Florida, we've built our reputation on quality work, transparent communication, and lasting relationships with our clients.

From the first consultation to the final walkthrough, we work closely with homeowners and contractors to bring every vision to life — on time and within budget.

  • Licensed & Insured Contractor
  • Free Estimates & Consultations
  • Residential & Commercial Projects
  • On-Time, On-Budget Delivery
Work With Us
How It Works

Simple Process, Outstanding Results

01

Free Consultation

We meet at your home, listen to your vision, evaluate the space, and discuss timelines — no cost, no pressure.

02

Detailed Estimate

You receive a clear, itemized estimate so you know exactly what to expect: materials, labor, and timeline.

03

Expert Build

Our team gets to work with precision and care. We keep you informed throughout and treat your home with total respect.

04

Final Walkthrough

We review every detail with you before calling it done. Your satisfaction is the only benchmark that matters.
